description.value: Chicken World is a BC-based fast food chain specializing in fried and Peri Peri chicken pieces, burgers, wraps, and classic sides like poutine and onion rings. This Surrey location on 72 Avenue offers indoor seating, drive-thru service, and online ordering for maximum convenience. The menu spans everything from individual chicken pieces to multi-piece family packs, with a veggie burger rounding out the options.
